newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -4.0 Feb 23 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -4.0 Feb 23 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort fell one point to -4.0 in the week ended February 23 from -3.0 the prior week.

The survey, this time with 1,035 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy fell to -2.0 from 0.0 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances fell to 16 from 18, while Americans' rating of buying climate remained steady at -26.
Confidence fell in to a six-week low in the Northeast, down four points to -4.0, while it also dropped to a six-week low in Midwest down one point to -3.0.
Confidence in the South and West held steady at -4.0 and -3.0, respectively.
